stages.choice_rule: Four whole words each item. Include the pictured lemma and its true homophone. Add two other roots-list or allowed_extra words. For three-way sets, use all three spellings plus one extra same-sound word. One right answer. Never IPA, letters, or picture prose.

gold_items.stem: Pick the word that fits best.

roots: Always include the true homophone of the pictured answer. Never offer two spellings that both name the picture.
Wrong choices are whole words from the wordlist or allowed_extra_words. Never letters, IPA, or invented audio.
The media lemma must be the answer word. Do not name or describe the picture in the stem.
Tier 1 extra distractors are unrelated kid nouns from home, school, food, pets, or play.
Tier 2 add one look-alike that shares letters or meaning, plus the true homophone.
Tier 3 use a three-way or four-way same-sound set such as to/too/two/tow or right/write/rite/wright.
Keep answers mixed across choice slots. Use <NAME> only, never a real name.
Kid world only. No brands. One tap. One right answer.

tier_rules.1: Stems of three to five words. A clear pictured noun or number. Choices are that spelling, its homophone, and two unrelated kid nouns.
tier_rules.2: Stems of four to seven words. Keep the true homophone and add one look-alike that shares letters or a nearby meaning.
tier_rules.3: Near-miss four-way same-sound sets. Stems up to ten words. <NAME> is fine. The pictured lemma is still the only right spelling.

see_sea.en: See means look. Sea means the water.

ate_eight.en: Ate means you finished food. Eight is the number 8.

be_bee.en: Be means is or are. A bee is a flying bug.
be_bee.ko: Be는 is나 are처럼 쓰여요. Bee는 꿀벌이에요.

blew_blue.en: Blew means the wind moved. Blue is a color.
blew_blue.ko: Blew는 바람이 불었다는 뜻이에요. Blue는 색깔이에요.

plain_plane.en: A plane flies in the sky. Plain means simple.
plain_plane.ko: Plane은 하늘을 나는 비행기예요. Plain은 단순한 것이라는 뜻이에요.

night_knight.en: Night is when it is dark. A knight is a brave helper.
night_knight.ko: Night는 어두운 밤이에요. Knight는 용감한 기사예요.

to_too_two.en: Two is the number 2. To means toward. Too means also or very.
to_too_two.ko: Two는 숫자 2예요. To는 '~로'라는 뜻이에요. Too는 '너무' 또는 '또'예요.

right_write.en: Write means to make words. Right means correct or that side.
right_write.ko: Write는 글을 쓴다는 뜻이에요. Right는 맞다 또는 오른쪽이라는 뜻이에요.

hear_here.en: Hear is what your ears do. Here means in this place.
hear_here.ko: Hear는 귀로 듣는다는 뜻이에요. Here는 바로 이곳이라는 뜻이에요.

one_won.en: One is the number 1. Won means you came in first.

buy_by.en: Buy means to get something with money. By means near.
buy_by.ko: Buy는 돈으로 산다는 뜻이에요. By는 옆에 있다는 뜻이에요.

for_four.en: Four is the number 4. For means this is meant for someone.

hole_whole.en: A hole is an empty spot. Whole means all of it.

mail_male.en: Mail is a letter. Male means a boy or man.

ant_aunt.en: An ant is a tiny bug. An aunt is a mom or dad's sister.
ant_aunt.ko: Ant는 작은 개미예요. Aunt는 엄마나 아빠의 자매예요.

beat_beet.en: A beet is a red food. Beat means to win or hit a drum.
beat_beet.ko: Beet는 빨간 채소예요. Beat는 이기다 또는 북을 친다는 뜻이에요.

sun_son.en: The sun is in the sky. A son is a boy in a family.
sun_son.ko: Sun은 하늘의 해예요. Son은 가족의 아들이에요.

eye_i.en: An eye is for looking. I means me.
eye_i.ko: Eye는 눈으로 본다는 뜻이에요. I는 나를 뜻해요.

wood_would.en: Wood comes from a tree. Would means you might do it.
wood_would.ko: Wood는 나무에서 온 목재예요. Would는 할지도 모른다는 뜻이에요.

sail_sale.en: A sail is on a boat. A sale is when things cost less.
sail_sale.ko: Sail은 배의 돛이에요. Sale은 값이 내린 판매예요.

wear_where.en: Wear means to put on clothes. Where asks about a place.
wear_where.ko: Wear는 옷을 입는다는 뜻이에요. Where는 장소를 물어요.

red_read.en: Red is a color. Read means you looked at words.
red_read.ko: Red는 색깔이에요. Read는 글을 읽었다는 뜻이에요.

flower_flour.en: A flower grows in a garden. Flour is for baking.
flower_flour.ko: Flower는 정원에 피는 꽃이에요. Flour는 빵 만드는 가루예요.

bear_bare.en: A bear is a big animal. Bare means nothing is on it.
bear_bare.ko: Bear는 큰 곰이에요. Bare는 아무것도 없다는 뜻이에요.

pear_pair.en: A pear is a fruit. A pair means two.
pear_pair.ko: Pear는 과일이에요. Pair는 두 개라는 뜻이에요.

weather_whether.en: Weather is rain, sun, or wind. Whether means if.
weather_whether.ko: Weather는 비, 해, 바람 같은 날씨예요. Whether는 '~인지'라는 뜻이에요.

threw_through.en: Threw means you tossed it. Through means from one side to the other.
threw_through.ko: Threw는 던졌다는 뜻이에요. Through는 한쪽에서 다른 쪽으로예요.

tide_tied.en: Tide is the sea moving. Tied means you made a knot.
tide_tied.ko: Tide는 바닷물이 오르내리는 거예요. Tied는 묶었다는 뜻이에요.

new_knew.en: New means not old. Knew means you had it in your mind.
new_knew.ko: New는 새것이라는 뜻이에요. Knew는 알고 있었다는 뜻이에요.

our_hour.en: Our means it belongs to us. An hour is time on the clock.
our_hour.ko: Our는 우리 것이라는 뜻이에요. Hour는 시계의 한 시간이에요.

no_know.en: No means not yes. Know means you have it in your mind.
no_know.ko: No는 아니라는 뜻이에요. Know는 알고 있다는 뜻이에요.

your_youre.en: Your means it belongs to you. You're means you are.
your_youre.ko: Your는 네 것이라는 뜻이에요. You're는 you are라는 뜻이에요.

there_their.en: There means in that place. Their means it belongs to them.
there_their.ko: There는 저곳이라는 뜻이에요. Their는 그들의 것이라는 뜻이에요.

hair_hare.en: Hair grows on your head. A hare is like a rabbit.
hair_hare.ko: Hair는 머리에 나는 털이에요. Hare는 토끼 같은 동물이에요.

which_witch.en: Which asks you to pick. A witch is a person in a story.
which_witch.ko: Which는 고르라고 묻는 말이에요. Witch는 이야기 속 마녀예요.

week_weak.en: A week is seven days. Weak means not strong.
week_weak.ko: Week는 이레, 일주일이에요. Weak는 힘이 없다는 뜻이에요.

meat_meet.en: Meat is food. Meet means to see someone.
meat_meet.ko: Meat는 고기 음식이에요. Meet는 누군가를 만난다는 뜻이에요.
